permissions.none: No local file access. Existing conversation context remains available.
permissions.workspace: Read-only access to open workspace folders, excluding private files.
permissions.computer: Read-only access to local and network-share files, excluding private files.
permissions.description: File permission for future Beacon responses. Current responses keep their original permission. Read content is sent to the selected model service.
settings.webEnabled: Allow the selected tool-capable model to search public information through Exa without a search API key. Changes during generation apply to the next response.
settings.modelConfiguration: Beacon model settings document. Manage connections, models and parameters in the Beacon Settings editor tab. Old configuration is not read or migrated.
